description: Measurements captured automatically while the compiler inspects a plan. Missing values mean the operation could not observe that measurement.

alternatives_considered.description: Number of accepted methods on tasks that offer more than one accepted method, so each counted method competes in selection.

constraint_count.description: Number of objective constraints (budget, deadline, quality floor, acceptance criteria) plus order edges of non-rejected methods.

context_size_chars.description: Rendered context size in characters for `context` operations.

contract_rejections.description: Number of candidate methods rejected by contract validation.

critical_path_changes.description: Tasks that entered or left the critical path since the previous recorded run of the same plan file with the same selection objective and time budget. Null without a compiled operation or such a run.

critical_path_tasks.description: Tasks on the critical path, for compiled operations.

decisions_affected_by_evidence.description: Number of recorded decisions whose supporting tasks or capabilities gained evidence timestamped after the decision. Null when the decision log cannot be read.

estimate_uncertainty_minutes.description: Aggregate expected duration range width in minutes, when compiled.

evidence_coverage.description: Fraction of plan capabilities with at least one evidence record; evidence on subjects not in the plan does not count.

frontier_duration_ms.description: P8 frontier-ranking wall-clock duration in milliseconds, for `frontier` operations only.

id.description: Stable event identifier supplied by the recorder.

memory_bytes.description: Process resident memory in bytes, when available.

method_count.description: Number of methods in the checked plan.

operation.description: Operation which produced the observation: `check`, `compile`, `frontier`, or `context`.

optimality_gap_percent.description: Solver optimality gap in percent, when exposed by the solver.

plan_file.description: File name of the plan the run read; plans sharing a directory share one log.

plan_revision.description: Revision of the plan used for the event.

schema_version.description: Event schema version. PC-02 defines version 1.

selection_duration_ms.description: Selection solver wall-clock duration in milliseconds.

selection_objective.description: P6 selection objective (`effort` or `makespan`), when compiled.

selection_time_budget_ms.description: P6 selection time budget in milliseconds, when compiled.

source.description: Event producer, such as `pc-cli` or an agent identifier.

task_count.description: Number of tasks in the checked plan.

title: CompilerRunEvent
